note: Size budgets for the built output. Checked by `npm run budget`, enforced in CI.
`limit` is a ceiling somebody chose. `measured` is what the build produced when
the limit was last recorded, kept beside it so the headroom is visible without
running anything. Refresh the measurements with `npm run budget:update`; that
command deliberately does NOT touch the limits.
Raising a limit is a commit with a reason. The limits below were set at the
first measurement (2026-08-14, commit b066c89) with roughly 5% headroom on the
text bundles and the asset trees. demo-css-gzip is the exception: at 7 KB, 5%
is 360 bytes and one new component's classes would trip it, so it carries a
flat ceiling instead of a percentage.
lib-esm-gzip guards a property, not a size: the ESM entry externalises three
and bezier-js as peerDependencies. Losing that config takes it from ~81 KB to
~423 KB, so the limit is set well below the bundled figure and nowhere near
